assignment_specifications.s0: PRIMARY: fixed geometry unique within=covered_by same sole village; original district readable and consistent; no explicit address/spatial conflict
assignment_specifications.s1: SENSITIVITY: fixed geometry unique only; district/address conflicts retained
assignment_specifications.s2: SENSITIVITY: source-year historical boundary plus same conservative tests as S0
assignment_specifications.s3: SENSITIVITY: source-year historical geometry unique only

assignment_priority.invalid_coordinates: 2 非缺失但不可解析／非有限／候選經緯度越界或投影失敗
assignment_priority.boundary_nonunique: 4 共同邊界／頂點或單一邊界；不是唯一內部
assignment_priority.multiple_geometry: 5 多個內部或其他多重幾何候選，不任選第一筆
assignment_priority.original_district_unknown: 7 幾何唯一但來源區名無法確認
assignment_priority.district_conflict: 8 幾何唯一但來源區名與空間區名衝突
assignment_priority.address_conflict: 9 幾何唯一且來源區名一致，但可判讀地址與空間區名衝突
assignment_priority.conservative_success: 10 唯一內部、原區名明確一致、地址沒有明確空間衝突

NA_comparison: both NA=equally unassigned; one NA vs ID=different eligibility; two valid IDs compare strings; geometric village change requires both valid
area_denominators: S0/S1 use fixed original village_area; historical geographic density S2/S3 uses corresponding historical_area_year. An explicitly labelled common fixed-denominator comparison is different. No density constructed in Unit2.2.
limitations: historical year editions are snapshots, not every-day legal validity
no fixed geometry snap/repair/hole fill/overlap removal
provisional_match Tangbu accepted for all main analyses; original names and status retained
no nearest village, external coordinate correction or geocoding
no final village-level Dataset A/B1/B2/B3/C or final low-count threshold
zero observed assigned accidents is not proof of no real accidents
description and technical acceptance do not imply DA/PM human review
